idea-plugin.name: RDS Extended Support Cost Lint for Terraform
idea-plugin.description:
Prices the AWS Extended Support surcharge on every RDS and Aurora database in your .tf files

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → RDS Extended Support Cost Lint for Terraform: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/rds-extended-support-cost-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/rds-extended-support-cost-lint
